reviews.title: It’s just not good in general
reviews.text: The app is so hard to navigate and the filters are just so random

reviews.title: Constantly downgrading
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years, and even though they should ostensibly have more resources to keep it bug free from starting to charge people to use it, it has glitches galore. I think it’s time to migrate to something else.

reviews.title: Basic functionality missing
reviews.text: Why can we not view our media by aspect ratio!! Instead we have to guess if the image we are looking to add is portrait of landscape, only to get it wrong and have to start all over again. If this was fixed, I’d say it would be a useful app, until then, it’s just more a pain than a help

reviews.title: Watermark
reviews.text: I paid money for certain lay outs a long time ago. Now they have watermarks on them even though I paid for them, and I have to pay even more money now for a subscription despite having already paid for what I wanted out of the app. Money down the drain.

reviews.title: What happened to this app
reviews.text: I haven’t used Unfold in a while and opened it today. Didn’t realise they were bought by squarespace. Now everything is locked behind a paywall, the most basic layouts are not usable. Overall navigation is hard, I struggled to find my way around. I remember using unfold a couple of years ago and it was the total opposite experience of this one. Sad to see another small business having been sold to a big player who then ruined it.

reviews.title: downhill
reviews.text: the pictures look clear when editing but after you save it, it’s blurry :/

reviews.title: Asking for Reviews All Yhe Time
reviews.text: Great app but asks for reviews every time I open it! Give it a break!!

reviews.title: Reels problem
reviews.text: This used to be a great content creation app, but now it’s close to useless for making reels from scratch. It strips away the original audio no matter what you do- even if you make sure the clip isn’t muted. It seems like such an easy issue to fix, yet as it stands, the only sound option for reels is choosing something from their library of awfully sounding tracks.

reviews.title: Impossible to log in
reviews.text:
I’m just spending way too much time trying to log into this app. I keep doing the exact same thing over and over again, and somehow it only works on like the sixth try. It’s insanely frustrating.

This has happened multiple times already. The app logs me out, and then the same hell starts all over again.

I just don’t have the energy for this anymore, so goodbye.

reviews.title: No free features anymore
reviews.text: This app used to be good, now they won’t let me download one of my own photos against just a white backdrop.. not everything needs to be paid, sir. Deleted.

reviews.title: Text options
reviews.text: Why can’t we bold an individual word in a sentence? Instead it bolds the entire sentence. Please improve this!

reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text: Use to be a really good app for editing. Now just like the other slop on this app store, you need to pay for a subscription just to remove a watermark.

reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: whenever you try to trim something it doesnt start it from where you trimmed it what a terrible app and design

reviews.title: HELP
reviews.text:
I understand the ig planner feature has been retired, but I had already spent several hours planning a lot of posts inside the Instagram planner before it was removed.

Is there any way the previously saved plan still exists in your system or database? Even a simple export, list, or screenshot of the planned posts would help me recover the work I did.

I would really appreciate any help retrieving that information if it’s still available.

Thank you so much.

reviews.title: Works well, not high resolution
reviews.text: I enjoy using Unfold for fun social media posts, but the program compresses the heck out of the images when you export out of Unfold. Really the most disappointing part of it. Don’t let any of their spin make you think otherwise — I even pay for pro. I tried to work around by saving as PDF and converting, but nope, the app compresses the high resolution images as soon as you use any of their templates. Not worth paying for.

reviews.title: Removed Feed Planner from Plus
reviews.text: Super disappointed to log onto my app today to see that the Instagram feed planner has been removed from my Plus subscription. It is now only available on a Pro subscription which costs considerably more. Sadly I’ll likely be cancelling my subscription and finding a different app

reviews.title: Can’t access the app
reviews.text: I have had this app for years. It forced me to update to this new version which is requiring me to create an account. Totally fine. However I keep getting an error saying I don’t have enough storage on my phone? What does that have to do with creating an account or accessing my older images? I have used 1/6 of my iPhone storage (I have over 400gb left). This new app version is a joke. All in the name of a monthly subscription.

reviews.title: Warning won’t let you refund an accidental charge!!!! We requested the refund twice both rejected!!!
reviews.text: Didn’t let me refund a charge that was not intended on the same day it was charged.

reviews.title: Move with the times
reviews.text: When are you going to update the app to reflect 3:4 ratio posts?

reviews.title: terrible update
reviews.text: made the mistake of updating the app. They’re following the same business model as VSCO & created a subscription model for features that were already paid for or features that consumers previously had access to. Time to move onto a new app. Terrible decision to do to long time users. Have been using unfold for many years.

reviews.title: Was such a great app until I needed to make a login/account.
reviews.text: Deleting this after using this for 5+ years. Making unfold into “unfold:reels and story maker” with an option to go “pro” is such a sell out disappointment. I won’t be recommending this any more sadly. Bring back the old version /:

reviews.title: Switched to square space and now it’s awful
reviews.text: Ever since they got bought out by square space I have lost access to the filter packages I PAID FOR and cannot get any help from customer service. I can’t even log into my account any more. I’m deleting the app. Thanks for nothing

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: A terrible mistake paying for this app. It’s so basic and never has updates. I paid like $70 for the year and that doesn’t even get me the pro version. Muse app is 10x better! Don’t waste your money!

reviews.title: Standard pay wall downgrade
reviews.text: Used to love unfold, now pretty much everything even super basic features are behind a paywall/subscription begging constantly. A real shame!

reviews.title: Decent app but not for Insta reels use
reviews.text: Easy enough to use but I cancelled subscription as the templates work poorly with Instagram reels - template texts boxes clash with the Instagram screen clutter making text unreadable. Also images bleed off Reels format. Seems like a very basic thing to get right.

reviews.title: Started out great, ruined by greed
reviews.text:
This app used to be great and fairly priced. Opened it recently after a year or so and wow what an absolute disaster they’ve made of it. Buggy, multiple subscriptions, and payroll over basic features and layouts. Ended up just using Photoshop.

Greed is really a sad way for this app to go out.

reviews.title: External Keyboard & Mic don’t work on IOS platforms
reviews.text: Unless one wants to peck away at a tiny keyboard, this app does not work on an iPad or iPhone. Tried all the suggestions with no success. At least make the mic work!!

reviews.title: No longer good
reviews.text: I use squarespace for my website. Because of that I had used unfold app. It used to be good and worthwhile. But now they have increased the cost a ridiculous amount and not updated their templates or offerings. Also most of the time my bio site does not work and I'm unable to update it and that was even after paying for a subscription. Now the subscription is more. It's really not worth it anymore and there are better options.

reviews.title: Super Buggy
reviews.text: It’s a great app when it works, but lately it likes to freeze and not wok in general, like people are pumping out updates to keep up with whoever without fully testing anything

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: I like this app and was planning on buying pro subscription. However, the app is so buggy, it’s frustrating. It freezes every time I click on the plan (icon highlights but the screen doesn’t change to the schedule) then it freezes. (iPhone 17 pro / latest OS)

reviews.title: Unable to even log in after update
reviews.text: I made the mistake of updating the app after having the free version for years. Now everything is lost and I can’t even create a log in for some full storage error message.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Unable to publish a new bio site or update an existing one. What am I paying for?
